children: Indonesia spent 134.2 trillion rupiah ($7.56 billion) on the country's free meals programme from January to August, its finance minister Suahasil Nazara said on Friday.
The programme had reached 57 million recipients by the end of August, with 27,485 kitchens operating nationwide, he added.
